facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident during a breakdown response on P-3221

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3221 and M-3221 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. P-3221 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 19 March 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on P-3221 and M-3221 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
